goal: A page that helps participants understand a creative technology event
user_meaning: Explore and decide whether and how to attend

alternatives.meaning_interpretation: Many disciplines meet and change one another
alternatives.visual_relationship: Different forms interact and transform across sections
alternatives.design_tradeoff: Could confuse program details if visuals dominate
alternatives.how_to_test: Ask visitors to identify festival premise and next action

alternatives.meaning_interpretation: A navigable sequence of three festival days
alternatives.visual_relationship: A temporal reading path organized around session transitions
alternatives.design_tradeoff: Could feel procedural rather than celebratory
alternatives.how_to_test: Test finding a specific session and date

alternatives.meaning_interpretation: An open laboratory to discover unexpected ideas
alternatives.visual_relationship: Layered discoveries with progressive disclosure of program details
alternatives.design_tradeoff: May hide essential facts before interaction
alternatives.how_to_test: First-impression recall and task success separately
